messages.subject: For Paulo Ruiz | Electrification, energy transition and government stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Tolhurst,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Paulo Ruiz, Chief Executive Officer.

Eaton's electrification and power-management strategy increasingly depends on disciplined alignment across governments, utilities, customers, sustainability priorities and major infrastructure investment. That intersection closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of energy-transition, government relations and stakeholder strategy might support Eaton's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Eaton.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
